confidence_notes: Aswan's accessible city-level food survey is sparse and dated (Numbeo shows only three contributors in the prior 12 months); it supports inexpensive meals and cappuccino better than tourist-facing mid-range dining. Beer prices are not reported there, alcohol availability and pricing vary by venue, and the cocktail figure is from one restaurant listing rather than a citywide survey. Wine is estimated relative to local beer. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates based on southern Egypt's Nile-tourism market and general knowledge; no live accommodation listings were consulted.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food anchors use Aswan's limited city-level price observations; accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of southern Egypt's Nile-tourism destinations, with Luxor as the closest broad comparison.
